build_WM_detection_loss: build a WMDetectionLoss module to compute watermark detection loss with configurable positive and negative weights
create_WM_Mb_loss: create a WMMbLoss module to compute masked sample-level detection loss using bce or mse loss type
test_WMDetectionLoss_forward: test the WMDetectionLoss forward pass with positive negative tensors and a mask to compute detection loss
test_WMMbLoss_forward: test the WMMbLoss forward pass with watermarked outputs mask and message to compute decoding loss
review_WM_loss_classes: review the WMDetectionLoss and WMMbLoss classes for watermark detection and message decoding loss computation
